text: An isolated singularity z0 of f is a pole of order m when the Laurent series about z0:
choices: has finitely many negative-power terms, the lowest being (z - z0)^(-m)
explanation: A pole of order m has a finite principal part terminating at (z - z0)^(-m). No negative powers means a removable singularity; infinitely many negative powers means an essential singularity (with Casorati-Weierstrass/Picard behavior nearby).
